title: Silurian CEO Testifies Before House Environment Subcommittee
summary: CEO, Jayesh K. Gupta, speaks before House Environment Subcommittee
body_markdown:
## July 16th, 2025 at 10 AM EST.


Silurian CEO, Jayesh K. Gupta, will deliver testimony before the US House Subcommittee on Environment, outlining how foundation models are transforming the future of weather forecasting.


### Protecting Lives and Property: Harnessing Innovative Technologies to Enhance Weather Forecasting
